headline: Dhanuka Agritech Limited: Updates
sum: Updates — Dhanuka Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Approval of granting of loan upto Rs. 15 Crore in one or more tranches to the proposed Dhanuka Employee Stock Benefits Trust for the sole purpose of acquisition of…
detail: Updates — Dhanuka Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Approval of granting of loan upto Rs. 15 Crore in one or more tranches to the proposed Dhanuka Employee Stock Benefits Trust for the sole purpose of acquisition of equity shares from open market and administration of SAR 2026 in accordance with the provisions of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Share Based Employee Benefits and Sweat Equity) Regulations, 2021.'.
